deepClone: prefer structuredClone, fall back to JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)).

formatDate: Intl.DateTimeFormat with month: 'short', day, year, .format(...).
formatRelativeTime: computes diff in seconds, returns 'just now' / Nm ago / Nh ago / Nd ago / formatted date for old dates.
groupBy<T,K>: reduces arr to Record<K, T[]> using keyFn(item).
